blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) support a wide range of histopathology tasks on whole-slide images through multiple instance learning (MIL). Despite recent progress, these models remain sensitive to cross-hospital distribution shifts: performance often degrades when a task head (e.g., classification) is trained on data from one hospital and then used on data from another hospital. To address this challenge, we propose AdaptMIL, a training strategy for integrating domain adaptation into MIL training. AdaptMIL is motivated by our finding that directly applying domain adaptation objectives during MIL training can interfere with MIL aggregation learning, often resulting in performance degradation over standard training. AdaptMIL resolves this by decoupling representation-level domain alignment learning from MIL aggregation learning through a two-stage training procedure. We show that AdaptMIL improves cross-hospital performance and outperforms alternative adaptation methods across experiments spanning multiple WSI datasets, tasks, PFMs, MIL architectures, and domain adaptation objectives. AdaptMIL's code will be released upon publication.
blocks.zh: 病理基础模型(PFMS)通过多例学习(MIL)支持全滑坡图像上的广泛组织病理任务. 尽管最近取得了进展,但这些模型仍然对跨医院分布变化敏感:当一个任务主管(如分类)接受一个医院的数据培训,然后用于另一个医院的数据时,性能往往会下降。 为了应对这一挑战,我们提议采用适应性综合培训(Adapital)这一培训战略,将适应领域纳入适应性综合培训。 适应 MIL的动机是我们发现,在MIL培训期间直接应用域内适应目标会干扰MIL汇总学习,往往导致业绩比标准培训低。 适应 MIL通过两个阶段的培训程序,将代表级域对接学习与MIL汇总学习脱钩来解决这个问题. 我们显示,AdapitalMIL改进了跨医院的性能,并且超越了跨越多个WSI数据集、任务、PFM、MIL架构和域内适应目标的实验的替代适应方法。 适应 MIL的代码将在出版后发布.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
The emergence of modern pathology foundation models (PFMs) has driven substantial progress in digital pathology in recent years ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Filiot et al., 2025 ) .
These models take digitized tissue images as input and produce general-purpose representations that can support a wide range of downstream histopathology tasks, including cancer detection, tumor subtyping, biomarker prediction, and survival analysis ( Neidlinger et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
近年来,现代病理学基础模型(PFMs)的出现推动了数字病理学的重大进展(Chen等人,2024年;Lu等人,2024年;Filiot等人,2025年)。
这些模型将数字化的组织图像作为输入,并产生能够支持广泛的下游组织病理学任务的通用表示,包括癌症检测,肿瘤亚型,生物标志预测,以及生存分析(Neidlinger等人,2026年).

blocks.en:
Unlike conventional image encoders that process standard-sized images, PFMs are used to process extremely large images, commonly referred to as whole-slide images (WSIs), which can contain billions of pixels.
This requires a specialized processing pipeline: a WSI is first divided into smaller patches, each patch is independently encoded by a PFM into a patch-level representation, and finally, the patch representations are aggregated into a single slide-level embedding using a weakly supervised multiple instance learning (MIL) module, most commonly trained from scratch per task ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Shao et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
与处理标准大小图像的常规图像编码器不同,PFM用于处理极大的图像,通常称为全滑行图像(WSI),可以包含数十亿像素.
这需要专门的处理管道:一个WSI首先分为较小的补丁,每个补丁被一个PFM独立编码成一个补丁级代表,最后,补丁代表被集合成一个单一的幻灯片级嵌入,使用一个弱监督的多实例学习(MIL)模块,最常见的是从零开始对每个任务的训练(Wang等人,2024年;Shao等人,2025年).

blocks.en:
Despite their progress, PFM-based MIL pipelines may still struggle in real-world deployment conditions.
A major challenge is their limited robustness to variability across hospitals from which tissue samples were collected, arising from differences in tissue processing protocols ( Kömen et al., 2026 ) .
As a result, the performance of task heads (e.g., classifiers) built on PFM representations degrades when the MIL module and task head are trained on data from one hospital and used on data from another ( Fernandez-Romero et al., 2026 ; Umer et al., 2026 ) .
This poses a practical limitation, since labeled data from a specific target hospital is often unavailable
due to costly and time-consuming expert annotation,
whereas unlabeled data from that hospital may be readily available.
Meanwhile, labeled data from other source hospitals may already be available, a setting known as unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) ( Wilson and Cook, 2020 ) .
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了进步,但基于PFM的MIL输油管在现实世界的部署条件下仍然会挣扎。
一个重大挑战是,由于组织处理规程的差异,它们对于收集组织样品的医院的可变性作用有限(Kömen等人,2026年)。
因此,在MIL模块和任务负责人接受来自一家医院的数据培训并使用来自另一家医院的数据时,基于PFM表示法的任务负责人(如分类员)的性能会下降(Fernandez-Romero等人,2026年;Umer等人,2026年)。
这构成了实际限制,因为往往无法获得特定目标医院的标签数据。
由于昂贵和耗时的专家注释,
而该医院提供的无标签数据可能很容易获得。
同时,其他源头医院的标签数据可能已经存在,这种设置被称为无监督域适应(UDA)(Wilson and Cook, 2020).

blocks.en:
A direct approach is to fine-tune the pretrained PFM toward the target hospital domain.
This can be done using domain adaptation objectives in the UDA setting,
and requires labels for individual image patches from source-domain WSIs.
Although this approach has been explored before ( Vardi et al., 2026 ) , its applicability is limited by the scarcity of patch-level annotations in pathology.
By contrast, slide-level annotations are more readily available and can be used for end-to-end PFM fine-tuning. However, this requires propagating gradients from the slide-level objective through the MIL module and back through the PFM across hundreds or thousands of patches per slide, substantially increasing the computational cost compared with training the MIL module alone ( Campanella et al., 2025 ; Kumar and Vanderbilt, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
一个直接的方法是将经过预先训练的PFM调整到目标医院领域。
可使用UDA环境中的域适应目标,
并需要从源域WSI中为单个图像补丁设置标签.
虽然这一方法在之前已经探索过(Vardi等人,2026年),但由于病理学中缺乏补丁级说明,其适用性受到限制.
相比之下,滑动级说明更方便获得,可用于端到端的PFM微调. 然而,这需要通过MIL模块从幻灯片级目标传播梯度,然后通过PFM传播到每张幻灯片上百或数千个补丁,与仅培训MIL模块相比,计算成本大大增加(Campanella等人,2025年;Kumar和Vanderbilt,2026年)。

blocks.en:
Figure 1: AdaptMIL improves cross-hospital performance across PFMs such as UNI and H0-mini and across domain adaptation objectives.
It is motivated by the observation that directly applying standard UDA during MIL training often degrades performance.
blocks.zh:
图1: " 适应MIL " 改进了诸如UNI和H0-mini等PFM和域内适应目标的跨医院绩效。
其动机是观察到在MIL训练中直接应用标准的UDA往往会降低性能.

blocks.en:
In this work, we pursue a simpler alternative: we keep the pretrained PFM frozen and perform adaptation within the MIL training pipeline, using only slide-level supervision.
We find that a standard approach to unsupervised domain adaptation, which combines a task loss on the labeled source domain and a domain alignment objective to align the source and target domains, can fail when applied to MIL pipelines.
In particular, we find that domain alignment and learned MIL aggregation can interfere with one another: rather than learning more domain-invariant representations, the MIL module reduces the domain discrepancy by altering its aggregation pattern.
This can result in performance below source-only training.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们追求一种更简单的选择:我们保留预先训练的PFM冷冻,并在MIL训练管内进行改造,只使用滑动级监督.
我们发现,对无监督域的适应采用标准方法,将标签源域的任务损失和域对齐目标结合起来,使源域和目标域对齐,在应用到MIL管道时可能会失败.
特别是,我们发现域调和和所学的MIL聚合可以互相干扰:与其学习更多的域-变量表示,MIL模块通过改变其聚合模式来减少域差异.
这可能导致业绩低于纯源培训。

blocks.en:
To address this, we propose AdaptMIL , a two-stage MIL training strategy for domain adaptation that decouples domain alignment from aggregation learning.
The first stage trains a patch-level projection layer to make representations more domain-aligned and uses fixed mean pooling to aggregate them into slide-level representations.
Source–target domain alignment is performed on these slide-level representations together with a source task objective that preserves task-discriminative information.
In the second stage, the MIL aggregation is trained using the source task objective on top of the adapted projection layer learned in the first stage.
By performing domain alignment before learning the aggregation mechanism, AdaptMIL prevents the MIL module from altering its aggregation pattern to satisfy the alignment objective,
resulting in gains over source-only training ( Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
为了解决这个问题,我们提议采用Adapital-MIL(英语:Adapital-MIL)的两阶段Adapital-MIL培训策略,使域域协调与聚合学习脱钩.
第一阶段训练一个补丁级的投影层,使表示更加域对齐,并使用固定的平均值集合将其聚合成幻灯片级的表示.
源 - 目标域对准这些幻灯片级的表示,以及保留任务歧视信息的源任务目标。
在第二阶段,利用在第一阶段学到的经过调整的预测层之上的源任务目标对MIL汇总进行了培训。
通过在学习聚合机制之前进行域对齐,AdaptMIL防止了MIL模块改变其聚合模式以满足对齐目标,
使纯来源培训受益(图1)。

blocks.en:
Across experiments on multi-hospital datasets, we show that AdaptMIL outperforms source-only MIL training and alternative adaptation methods.
We demonstrate these gains across multiple PFMs, slide-level tasks, domain alignment objectives, and MIL aggregation methods.
Our code will be released upon publication.
blocks.zh:
在多医院数据集的实验中,我们显示,适应性MIL的绩效超过了仅来自源的MIL培训和替代适应方法.
我们通过多个PFM、幻灯片级任务、域对齐目标以及MIL汇总方法展示这些成果。
我们的密码一发布就会公布

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • We explore UDA in slide-level pathology MIL pipelines and identify a failure mode for jointly learning domain alignment and MIL aggregation. • We introduce AdaptMIL, a two-stage training strategy for MIL that decouples domain alignment from aggregation learning and can be applied across different MIL architectures. • We evaluate AdaptMIL across multiple pathology tasks, WSI datasets, PFMs, MIL architectures, and domain alignment objectives, and demonstrate improved cross-hospital performance over source-only training and other adaptation approaches.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献是: 我们在幻灯片级病理MIL管道中探索UDA,并找出一个失败模式,用于联合学习域对齐和MIL聚合. ^ 我们采用AdaptMIL,这是MIL的两阶段培训战略,将域域协调与汇总学习脱钩,并可在不同的MIL架构中应用。 我们通过多种病理任务评价适应MIL、WSI数据集、PFM、MIL架构和域协调目标,并展示高于纯源培训和其他适应方法的跨医院绩效。

blocks.zh: 我们在幻灯片级病理MIL管道中探索UDA,并确定联合学习域对齐和MIL聚合的故障模式.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Pathology foundation models and MIL
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 病理学基础模型和MIL

blocks.en:
Pathology foundation models (PFMs) encode hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained histopathology images into general-purpose embeddings that support a wide range of downstream tasks ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Filiot et al., 2025 ; Vorontsov et al., 2024 ) .
These representations are learned through large-scale pretraining, using objectives such as self-supervision ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Vorontsov et al., 2024 ) and vision-language contrastive learning ( Lu et al., 2024 ) .
In pathology practice, inference is performed on whole-slide images (WSIs), which often reach gigapixel scale (e.g., 100,000 × 100,000 100{,}000\times 100{,}000 pixels).
The predominant pipeline therefore segments the WSI, divides it into patches, encodes the patches independently using a PFM, and then aggregates the patch embeddings into a slide-level embedding using a multiple instance learning (MIL) module ( Wang et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
病理基础模型(PFMs)将血氧素和eosin(H&E)所覆盖的病理影像编码成支持广泛下游任务的通用嵌入物(Chen等人,2024年;Lu等人,2024年;Filiot等人,2025年;Worizonzo等人,2024年).
这些表述是通过大规模的预训来学习的,采用的目标包括自我监督(Chen等人,2024年;WonthOFF等人,2024年)和视觉语言对比学习(Lu等人,2024年)。
在病理学实践中,推论是在全滑动图像(WSI)上进行的,这些图像往往达到千兆像素的尺度(例如,10万×10万100{,}000\times 100{,}000像素).
因此,主要管道将WSI分割成补丁,使用PFM独立编码补丁,然后利用多实例学习模块将补丁嵌入到幻灯片层嵌入(Wang等人,2024年).

blocks.en:
MIL addresses learning from bags of instances for which supervision is available only at the bag level ( Dietterich et al., 1997 ) .
In digital pathology, a WSI is treated as a bag of patches ( Campanella et al., 2019 ) : while a WSI-level label may indicate, for example, the presence of cancer, labels for the individual patches are generally unavailable.
MIL methods therefore aggregate patch embeddings into a single slide-level representation from which the downstream task can be predicted.
blocks.zh:
MIL涉及从只有袋级监督的袋中学习的情况(Dieterich等人,1997年)。
在数字病理学中,一个WSI被作为袋状补丁处理(Campanella等人,2019年) :虽然一个WSI级的标签可能表明例如癌症的存在,但个别补丁的标签一般没有.
因此,MIL方法聚合补丁嵌入一个单一的幻灯片层代表,从中可以预测下游任务.

blocks.en:
A wide range of MIL methods have been proposed, varying along several dimensions, such as their aggregation mechanisms, architectures, and whether the aggregation is learnable or parameter-free.
An influential architecture is ABMIL ( Ilse et al., 2018 ) , which learns a network that assigns attention weights to instances and aggregates them through a weighted average.
Subsequent methods introduce more sophisticated aggregation mechanisms.
For example, DSMIL ( Li et al., 2021 ) identifies a critical instance and uses it to guide attention over the remaining instances, while TransMIL ( Shao et al., 2021 ) employs transformer-based attention to model dependencies between patches.
A common practice is to train MIL models from scratch for each downstream task, while more recent work has explored pretraining slide-level MIL models ( Ding et al., 2025 ; Shao et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
提出了范围广泛的MIL方法,在几个方面各不相同,例如其汇总机制、架构以及汇总是可学习的还是无参数的。
一个有影响力的建筑是ABMIL(Ilse等人,2018年),它学习了一个网络,将注意力权重分配给实例,并通过加权平均值将其聚合.
随后的方法引入了更复杂的聚合机制.
例如,DSMIL(Li等人,2021年)识别出一个临界实例,并用它来引导对剩余实例的注意,而TransMIL(Shao等人,2021年)则对补丁之间的模型依赖性采用基于变压器的注意.
通常的做法是从零开始为每一项下游任务培训MIL模型,而最近的工作则探索了预训幻灯片级MIL模型(Ding等人,2025年;Shao等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: 2.2 Cross-hospital robustness
blocks.zh: 2.2 跨医院坚固性

blocks.en:
Despite impressive performance, slide-level PFM pipelines may face limitations in real-world settings.
A major challenge emerges in multi-hospital settings due to variation in H&E appearance, driven by differences in tissue processing, staining, and digitization protocols ( Howard et al., 2021 ; Thiringer et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
尽管性能令人印象深刻,但幻灯片级的PFM管道在现实世界环境中可能面临限制.
由于组织处理、污渍和数字化协议的差异,在多医院环境中出现了一个重大挑战(H&E外观不同(Howard等人,2021年;Thiringer等人,2026年))。

blocks.en:
Prior work has examined cross-hospital robustness at the patch level, showing that PFM embeddings encode hospital-specific signatures and exhibit related distribution shifts ( Kömen et al., 2026 ) .
Proposed approaches to mitigate these shifts include test-time stain normalization of target patches ( Macenko et al., 2009 ; Reinhard et al., 2002 ) , training patch-level models with domain adaptation objectives ( Vray et al., 2024 ) , fine-tuning PFMs for domain alignment ( Vardi et al., 2026 ) , and learning transformations on top of frozen PFM features ( Kömen et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
先前的工作审查了补丁层面的跨医院坚固性,显示PFM嵌入了医院特定签名编码,并显示出相关的分配班次(Kömen等人,2026年)。
减轻这些变化的拟议方法包括目标补丁的试验时间污点正常化(Macenko等人,2009年;Reinhard等人,2002年),具有域适应目标的培训补丁水平模型(Vray等人,2024年),对域协调的PFM进行微调(Vardi等人,2026年),以及在冰冻的PFM特征之上的学习转变(Kömen等人,2026年)。

blocks.en:
Cross-hospital performance degradation has also been observed in slide-level tasks ( Fernandez-Romero et al., 2026 ; Umer et al., 2026 ) .
Several patch-level solutions can be transferred to slide-level prediction: stain normalization can be applied across all patches, while adapted PFMs can be used within MIL pipelines.
However, direct slide-level adaptation remains comparatively underexplored.
HASD ( Liu et al., 2025 ) takes this direction and proposes a pathology-specific hierarchical adaptation framework with several specialized objectives.
We also perform adaptation at the slide-aggregation level, but rather than introducing a specialized adaptation objective, we propose a training strategy that enables established domain adaptation objectives to be integrated into MIL.
blocks.zh:
在滑行级任务中也观察到了跨医院性能退化(Fernandez-Romero等人,2026年;Umer等人,2026年)。
几个补丁级的解决方案可以转移到幻灯片级预测:污点正常化可以适用于所有补丁,而经过改造的PFM可以在MIL管道内使用.
然而,直接的滑动水平适应仍然相对没有得到充分利用。
HASD(Liu等人,2025年)采取这一方向,并提出了具有若干专门目标的针对病理的分级适应框架。
我们还在幻灯片汇总一级开展适应工作,但我们建议了一项培训战略,使既定的适应领域目标能够纳入MIL,而不是引入一个专门的适应目标。

blocks.en: 2.3 Domain adaptation
blocks.zh: 2.3 领域适应

blocks.en:
Domain adaptation ( Wang and Deng, 2018 ) aims to transfer a model trained on data from a source domain to a different target domain.
Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) ( Wilson and Cook, 2020 ) is a common setting, where labeled source data is available, while only unlabeled data is available in the target domain.
blocks.zh:
域名改编(Wang and Deng, 2018)旨在将一个受过数据培训的模型从源域转移到另一个目标域.
无监督域适应(UDA)(Wilson and Cook, 2020)是一个常见的设置,这里有标签源数据,而目标域只有未标签数据.

blocks.en:
A central approach to UDA is domain-invariant feature learning, which aims to reduce differences between source and target representation distributions.
Invariant representations can be learned through discrepancy minimization methods, which minimize a differentiable distance metric between the two distributions.
Prominent examples include Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) ( Long et al., 2015 ) , local MMD (LMMD) ( Zhu et al., 2020 ) , and CORAL ( Sun and Saenko, 2016 ) .
Other domain-invariant methods use different mechanisms, such as domain-adversarial neural networks (DANN) ( Ganin et al., 2016 ) , which learns domain-invariant features by making representations from the source and target domains difficult to distinguish.
blocks.zh:
UDA的一种中心方法是域-不变量特征学习,其目的是减少源与目标代表分布之间的差异.
差异表示可以通过最小化方法学习,这种方法将两种分布之间的不同距离度量最小化.
突出的例子包括:最大平均差异(MMD)(Long等人,2015年),当地MMD(LMMD)(Zhu等人,2020年)和CORAL(Sun and Saenko,2016年).
其他域-变量方法使用不同的机制,例如域-对抗神经网络(DANN)(Ganin等人,2016年),通过使来自源域和目标域的表示难以区分来学习域-变量特征.

blocks.en:
Although widely used across computer vision and machine learning, the interaction between domain adaptation and MIL remains less explored in slide-level pathology.
In this work, we investigate this interaction and develop a training strategy for domain adaptation within MIL pipelines.
blocks.zh:
虽然在计算机视觉和机器学习中被广泛使用,但在幻灯片级病理学中,域适应和MIL之间的相互作用仍然较少被探索.
在这项工作中,我们调查了这种互动关系,并制定了在军事、军事和空中运输管道内进行领域调整的培训战略。

blocks.en:
As in standard domain-invariant UDA, the feature extractor (the PFM) can remain frozen while a learnable projection transforms its representations into a more domain-aligned space.
In many MIL architectures such a projection is already included prior to aggregation ( Shao et al., 2021 ; Ilse et al., 2018 ; Lu et al., 2021 ) , eliminating the need for an additional projection layer.
The MIL module and task head are thus trained jointly,
with the only difference from standard source-only MIL training (using only labeled source data and the task loss) being the addition of the domain adaptation loss.
blocks.zh:
和标准域-不变量UDA一样,特性提取器(the PFM)可以保持冷冻,而可学习的投影则将它的表示转换成一个更域对齐的空间.
在许多MIL架构中,这种投影在聚合之前就已经包括了(Shao等人,2021年;Ilse等人,2018年;Lu等人,2021年),从而不再需要额外的投影层.
因此,MIL单元和任务负责人得到联合培训,
与标准唯源的MIL训练(只使用标注的源数据和任务损失)的唯一区别是增加了域适应损失.

blocks.en: 3.2 Failure mode of domain adaptation and MIL training
blocks.zh: 3.2 域内适应和MIL培训失败模式

blocks.en:
We find that the application of UDA to MIL training ( Eq. 2 ) is mostly ineffective, performing worse than source-only training in most settings and providing only limited gains otherwise (see Fig. 1 ).
Analyzing this reveals a surprising effect: joint MIL and domain adaptation training substantially changes the learned attention pattern compared to standard MIL training, concentrating attention on a smaller subset of patches.
We demonstrate this effect in Fig. 2(a) :
Under UDA training, the top- k k attended patches in ABMIL account for a substantially larger fraction of the total attention (e.g., 2.8 × 2.8\times for k = 50 k=50 ).
This shows that the adaptation objective affects not only the learned projection layer, as might be expected, but also how patch information is aggregated by the MIL module.
blocks.zh:
我们发现,UDA在MIL培训(Eq.2)中的应用大多是无效的,在大多数情况下表现比纯源培训差,在其他方面只提供有限的收益(见图1)。
分析后发现一个令人惊讶的效果:与标准MIL培训相比,联合的MIL和域适应培训大大改变了学习到的注意模式,将注意力集中在较小的补丁子集上.
我们在图2(a)中表明了这种效果:
在UDA训练下,在ABMIL的上-k参加补丁占总注意力的相当大比例(例如,2.8×2.8\tims for k=50k=50).
这表明,适应目标不仅会像预期的那样影响学到的投影层,而且会影响MIL模块如何汇总补丁信息。

blocks.en:
Examining the training dynamics shows that both the task and domain adaptation losses decrease as expected ( Fig. 2(b) ), indicating that the optimization objectives are satisfied.
Together with the degradation in performance, this suggests that the MIL model takes advantage of a shortcut to reduce the domain gap.
That is, rather than learning genuinely more domain-robust representations, it can satisfy both objectives by changing how patch information is aggregated.
blocks.zh:
对培训动态的审查表明,任务和领域适应损失都如预期的那样减少(图2(b)),表明优化目标得到满足。
再加上性能的退化,这表明MIL模型利用捷径缩小域间隙.
也就是说,它不是真正学习更多领域-活性表述,而是能够通过改变补丁信息的汇总方式来满足两个目标。

blocks.en:
We hypothesize that this shortcut is facilitated by the morphological redundancy across patches in WSIs ( Song et al., 2024 ) , which may provide the MIL model with multiple ways to satisfy the task objective.
Adding the domain adaptation constraint may therefore push the model toward a different aggregation solution that, in this case, generalizes worse.
blocks.zh:
我们假设,这种快捷方式由WSIs(Song et al., 2024)中的补丁的形态冗余性所促进,这可能会为MIL模型提供满足任务目标的多种方式.
因此,增加域内适应限制可能会促使模型走向不同的汇总解决办法,在这种情况下,这种解决办法更为普遍。

blocks.en:
We emphasize that more concentrated attention is not inherently undesirable, as its effect depends on the regions receiving high attention and the quality of the representations.
Our analysis therefore does not imply that concentrated attention alone causes performance degradation.
Rather, it shows that domain adaptation can substantially alter the learned aggregation pattern,
even though the intended effect is to only make representations more domain-invariant,
and that these changes are associated with degraded performance.
blocks.zh:
我们强调,更加集中的注意力在本质上并不是不可取的,因为它的影响取决于那些得到高度关注的区域和代表的质量。
因此,我们的分析并不意味着仅仅集中关注会导致业绩下降。
相反,它表明域调整可以大大改变学到的汇总模式,
即使意图的效果只是使表述更具域-变量,
以及这些变化与业绩退化有关。

blocks.zh: 3.3 适应MIL

blocks.en:
Our analysis shows that applying domain adaptation objectives interferes with MIL aggregation learning.
This motivated us to try and decouple the two, namely separate domain-invariant representation learning from learning the aggregation mechanism.
We propose AdaptMIL , a two-stage training strategy that first learns domain-aligned representations and then learns the MIL aggregation over the adapted representations.
AdaptMIL is formulated here using ABMIL ( Ilse et al., 2018 ) but can be applied to different MIL architectures. See Fig. 3 for an illustration of AdaptMIL.

这促使我们尝试将两者脱钩,即从学习聚合机制中学习单独的域-变量代表。
我们提议采用“适应MIL”,即一个两阶段培训战略,首先学习域内对应表述,然后学习“适应MIL”的汇总,而不是经过调整表述。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Tasks and datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 任务和数据集

blocks.en:
We evaluate AdaptMIL on four different tasks.
The first is non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) subtyping between lung adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma, using 489 WSIs from TCGA ( Komura et al., 2022 ) across six hospitals, and 150 WSIs from an in-house hospital dataset.
The second task is renal cell carcinoma (RCC) subtyping between clear cell carcinoma and papillary cell carcinoma, using 307 WSIs from TCGA across three hospitals.
The third task is cancer detection, using 404 WSIs from CAMELYON17 ( Bandi et al., 2018 ) across five hospitals.
The fourth task is survival prediction, presented in Sec. D.3 of the supplementary material (Supp.).
blocks.zh:
我们评价适应 MIL执行四个不同的任务.
第一种是非小细胞肺癌(NSCLC)在肺腺癌和结膜细胞癌之间进行子化,使用来自TCGA(Komura等人,2022年)的489个WSI,分布于6家医院,150个WSI来自一个内部医院数据集.
第二个任务是肾细胞癌(RCC)在清晰的细胞癌和帕彼利细胞癌之间进行子打字,使用来自TCGA的307个WSI,横跨三家医院.
第三项任务是癌症检测,使用来自CAMELYON17(Bandi等人,2018年)的404个WPIS,覆盖五家医院.
第四个任务是补充材料(补编)第D.3节提出的生存预测。

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价

blocks.en:
For each subtyping or detection dataset, we evaluate all source-target hospital pairs and report the average metric across them. For example, the TCGA NSCLC dataset contains six hospitals, resulting in 30 source-target pairs. For the in-house lung dataset, we evaluate both directions with each of the six TCGA hospitals, resulting in 12 pairs.
Each source-target pair is evaluated using 3-fold cross-validation, with evaluation performed on held-out target WSIs that are not used during training.
Our main metric for subtyping and detection is balanced accuracy.
blocks.zh:

使用3倍的交叉验证对每对源目标进行评价,对在培训期间没有使用的被搁置目标西施进行评价。
我们潜质和探测的主要衡量标准是平衡的准确性。

blocks.en: 4.3 Models and training
blocks.zh: 4.3 模式和培训

blocks.en:
We evaluate AdaptMIL across different PFMs, domain adaptation objectives, and MIL architectures.
For patch-level feature extraction, we use three PFMs: UNI ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , CONCH-1.5 ( Lu et al., 2024 ) , and H0-mini ( Filiot et al., 2025 ) . Tissue segmentation, patch extraction, and feature extraction are performed using the TRIDENT package ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们评估适应MIL在不同的PFM、域适应目标和MIL结构中的应用。
对于补丁级特征提取,我们使用三种PFM:UNI(Chen等人,2024年),CONCH-1.5(Lu等人,2024年),H0-mini(Filiot等人,2025年). 组织分割、补丁提取和特征提取使用TRIDENT包(Zhang等人,2025年) 。

blocks.en:
We evaluate four domain adaptation objectives: three discrepancy-based losses, MMD ( Long et al., 2015 ) , LMMD ( Zhu et al., 2020 ) , and CORAL ( Sun and Saenko, 2016 ) , and the adversarial DANN objective ( Ganin et al., 2016 ) .
We further apply AdaptMIL to three MIL architectures: ABMIL ( Ilse et al., 2018 ) , DSMIL ( Li et al., 2021 ) , and TITAN ( Ding et al., 2025 ) .
The implementation for ABMIL is described in Sec. 3.3 . The implementations for DSMIL and TITAN follow the same principle with architecture-specific adjustments.
All AdaptMIL models are trained for 80 epochs, with 40 epochs for each stage.
Further implementation details are provided in Appendix A of the Supp.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了四个领域适应目标:三个基于差异的损失,MMD(Long等人,2015年),LMMD(Zhu等人,2020年)和CORAL(Sun and Saenko,2016年),以及对抗性的DANN目标(Ganin等人,2016年)。
我们进一步将DiftMIL应用于三个MIL架构:ABMIL(Ilse等人,2018年),DSMIL(Li等人,2021年),TITAN(Ding等人,2025年).
ABMIL的执行情况见Sec。 3.3 (英语). DSMIL和TITAN的实施工作也遵循了同样的原则,对建筑进行了具体调整。
所有适应性MIL模型都为80个世纪培训,每个阶段有40个世纪.
进一步的执行情况详见补编附录A。

blocks.en: 4.4 Method comparisons
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 方法比较

blocks.en:
We compare AdaptMIL against several baselines. First, we compare against source-only training with standard MIL. This baseline, commonly referred to as empirical risk minimization (ERM) ( Vapnik, 1999 ) , represents the out-of-distribution performance that domain adaptation aims to improve.
We also compare to standard UDA applied to MIL (defined in Eq. 2 ), using each of the four domain adaptation objectives. We refer to this baseline as single-stage UDA.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了适应MIL与若干基线。 首先,我们比较纯源培训与标准的MIL。 这一基准通常称为经验风险最小化(ERM)(Vapnik,1999年),代表着领域适应旨在改进的分配外业绩。
我们还比较了适用于MIL的标准UDA(定义为Eq.2),采用了四个域的适应目标中的每一个。 我们把这一基线称为单级UDA.

blocks.en:
We additionally compare against Macenko stain normalization ( Macenko et al., 2009 ) . In this setting, the MIL model is trained only on source data, as in ERM, but evaluation is performed on target images whose appearance is normalized to a source reference.
Finally, we compare against a domain adaptation approach that fine-tunes the PFM using patch-level supervision ( Vardi et al., 2026 ) .
We note that, to the best of our knowledge, other pathology-specific domain adaptation methods do not have publicly available implementations, and therefore we could not compare against them.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步与Macenko污点正常化进行比较(Macenko等人,2009年)。 在此情况下,MIL模型只接受源数据培训,如机构风险管理培训,但评价是在目标图像上进行的,其外观已与源参考标准正常化。
最后,我们比较了利用补丁级监督对PFM进行微调的域调整方法(Vardi等人,2026年)。
我们注意到,据我们所知,其他针对病理学的适应领域方法没有公开实施,因此我们无法加以比较。

blocks.en: 4.5 Results
blocks.zh: 4.5 结果

blocks.en:
Tab. 1 presents the evaluation of AdaptMIL with ABMIL across different PFMs and domain adaptation objectives on the NSCLC subtyping task.
AdaptMIL improves over ERM across all PFMs and objectives, with gains up to + 6.02 % +6.02\% in balanced accuracy.
MMD is the best-performing objective for two of the three PFMs, while LMMD and CORAL also yield notable gains, and DANN provides smaller improvements.
Similar trends are observed for ROC-AUC and F1 (see Tab. 6(b) in Supp.).
blocks.zh:
附表1介绍了对适应MIL与ABMIL的评价,涉及不同的PFM和关于NSCLC亚型任务的域内适应目标。
在所有方案风险管理和目标中,对机构风险管理的适应性提高,在平衡准确性方面,收益可达+6.02%+6.02%。
MMD是三个PFM中两个最出色的目标,而LMMD和CORAL也取得了显著的成绩,DANN提供的改进较小.
ROC-AUC和F1也有类似趋势(见补编中表6(b))。

blocks.en:
We additionally report in-domain performance of an ABMIL model that is trained and evaluated on samples from the same hospital.
The performance drop from in-domain to source-only ERM highlights the degradation caused by the cross-hospital distribution shift.
AdaptMIL substantially reduces this gap. For example, with UNI and CONCH-1.5, AdaptMIL recovers more than 80 % 80\% of the gap.
blocks.zh:
我们还报告对ABMIL模型进行实地培训并在同一医院样本上进行评估。
绩效从内域向唯一来源机构风险管理的下降,凸显了跨医院分布转移造成的退化。
适应MIL可以大大缩小这一差距。 例如,在UNI和CONCH-1.5中,AdaptMIL回收了80%以上的缺口。

blocks.en:
Table 3: Cross-hospital NSCLC TCGA subtyping results across different MIL architectures.
The metric is balanced accuracy (%).
blocks.zh:
表3:跨医院 NSCLC TCGA的子编译结果跨越了不同的MIL架构.
衡量标准是均衡的准确性(%)。

blocks.en: Table 4: Ablation studies for AdaptMIL.
blocks.zh: 表4: " 适应性MIL " 的校准研究。

blocks.en:
AdaptMIL outperforms the other adaptation methods.
As observed in Sec. 3.2 , directly applying standard single-stage UDA during MIL training often fails to improve over ERM and can substantially degrade performance. For example, LMMD with H0-mini reduces balanced accuracy by 20.24 % 20.24\% .
Macenko normalization also fails to improve performance, consistent with previous reports ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) .
Patch-level fine-tuning of PFMs is the baseline that provides the largest gains over ERM, but it remains inferior to AdaptMIL.
Although effective, patch-level fine-tuning requires both patch supervision and re-extraction of patch features for every source–target adaptation setting.
In contrast, AdaptMIL requires only slide-level supervision and operates on pre-extracted PFM features, allowing the same features to be reused across adaptation settings.
blocks.zh:
适应MIL优于其他适应方法.
如第3.2节所述,在军事和军事培训期间直接应用标准单级UDA往往不能改进机构风险管理,而且可以大幅度降低业绩。 例如,H0-mini的LMD将平衡精度降低20.24% 20.24\%.
Macenko正常化也未能改善业绩,这与以前的报告(Huang等人,2025年;Lin等人,2025年)是一致的。
PFM的补丁级微调是比机构风险管理提供最大收益的基线,但仍低于AdaptMIL.
虽然有效,但补丁级的微调需要补丁监督,并且需要在每个源–目标适应设置上重新提取补丁特征.
相比之下,AdaptMIL只要求幻灯片级监督,并在预提取的PFM特性上运行,允许相同的特性在适应设置中重复使用.

blocks.en:
We evaluate AdaptMIL across additional datasets and classification tasks in Tab. 2 .
AdaptMIL improves over source-only ERM in eight of the nine settings, with gains of up to + 8.12 % +8.12\% .
The only exception is cancer detection with CONCH-1.5, where ERM already achieves very strong performance.
In contrast, single-stage UDA degrades performance in seven of the nine settings.
blocks.zh:
我们通过Tab中的其他数据集和分类任务评估适应MIL。 2 (英语).
在9个设置中的8个设置中,适应MIL比纯源机构风险管理有所改进,收益最高可达+8.12%+8.12++===.
唯一的例外是用CONCH-1.5检测癌症,机构风险管理已经取得了非常强的业绩。
相比之下,单阶段的UDA在9个设置中的7个会降低性能.

blocks.en:
Finally, we evaluate AdaptMIL with MIL architectures beyond ABMIL in Tab. 4 .
AdaptMIL improves performance with DSMIL, although standard single-stage UDA is also effective. We further obtain a gain when adapting the pretrained TITAN slide encoder.
These results indicate that AdaptMIL is not specific to ABMIL and can be applied to other MIL architectures.
blocks.zh:
最后,我们评价了Tab中除ABMIL外的适应MIL与MIL架构. 4 (英语).
适应MIL改进了DSMIL的性能,虽然标准的单级UDA也是有效的. 在调整预装的TITAN幻灯片编码器时,我们进一步获得了收益.
这些结果表明,AdaptMIL并不是ABMIL特有的,可以应用于其他MIL架构.

blocks.en: 4.6 Ablations
blocks.zh: 4.6 拖欠款项

blocks.en:
We perform ablation studies to examine the impact of AdaptMIL’s components, with results for AdaptMIL-MMD with ABMIL and UNI in Tab. 4 .
We first consider an alternative way to decouple representation alignment from aggregation learning.
Instead of two-stage training, we train ABMIL throughout with the task objective, while applying the adaptation objective to a separate mean-pooling head placed after the projection layer.
This prevents adaptation gradients from reaching the attention module, while still adapting the projection layer.
This alternative method performs well (row 2 in Tab. 4 ), but remains inferior to AdaptMIL, suggesting an additional benefit from explicitly separating alignment and aggregation learning into distinct training stages.
blocks.zh:
我们进行减肥研究,以审查AditableMIL组件的影响,并将AditableMIL-MMD的结果与ABMIL和UNI放在Tab。 4 (英语).
我们首先考虑将代表制与汇总学习脱钩的替代办法。
我们不进行两阶段培训,而是在整个任务目标下对ABMIL进行培训,同时将适应目标应用于投影层之后的单独的平均集合头。
这使得适应梯度无法到达关注模块,同时仍然适应投影层.
这一替代方法运作良好(表4第2行),但仍低于适应MID,这表明明确将校对和汇总学习区分为不同的培训阶段还有好处。

blocks.en:
We next examine whether the second stage of AdaptMIL is necessary.
Specifically, we use only Stage 1, where the learned projection is followed by mean pooling and trained with both the task and adaptation objectives.
This performs worse than full AdaptMIL (row 3), confirming the benefit of using ABMIL, consistent with prior work favoring ABMIL over mean pooling ( Shao et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
接下来我们审查是否有必要进行第二阶段的适应MIDL。
具体地说,我们只使用第一阶段,在此阶段中,所学到的预测之后,将就任务和适应目标进行集中和培训。
这比完全适应的MIL(第3行)表现得更糟,证实了使用ABMIL的好处,这与以前的工作一致,它有利于ABMIL而不是平均集合(Shao等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
We additionally evaluate two design choices in Stage 2.
Keeping the adaptation loss active in Stage 2 degrades performance (row 4), supporting our hypothesis that adaptation gradients interfere with aggregation learning.
Not freezing the projection layer in Stage 2 slightly reduces performance (row 5), possibly because the projection becomes more source-oriented.
blocks.zh:
我们还在第二阶段评估两个设计选择。
在第二阶段保持适应损失的活性会降低性能(第4行),支持我们的假设,即适应梯度会干扰聚合学习.
不冻结第2阶段的投影层会略微降低性能(第5行),可能是因为投影变得更加面向源头.

blocks.en:
Finally, we test whether the two-stage training schedule itself contributes to the improvement by removing the adaptation objective (row 6).
This variant still improves over ERM, suggesting that separating representation and aggregation learning provides some benefit on its own.
However, it remains substantially below AdaptMIL, demonstrating the importance of the alignment in Stage 1.
blocks.zh:
最后,我们检验两阶段培训时间表本身是否通过取消适应目标(第6项)来推动改进。
这一变式仍然比机构风险管理有所改进,表明将代表性和汇总学习分开,本身可以提供一些好处。
然而,它仍然远远低于适应性综合设施,表明第一阶段调整的重要性。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduce AdaptMIL, a training strategy for performing domain adaptation within MIL architectures.
Motivated by the observation that applying standard UDA to MIL can interfere with aggregation learning and degrade performance, AdaptMIL decouples domain alignment and aggregation learning into two training stages.
Evaluated in cross-hospital adaptation settings with different tasks, PFMs, MIL architectures, and domain adaptation objectives, AdaptMIL consistently improves over source-only training and outperforms alternative adaptation methods.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍了AdaptMIL,这是在MIL架构内进行域内适应的培训战略.
有观点认为,将标准的UDA应用到MIL会干扰集合学习和降解性能,适应MIL解耦域对齐和集合学习分两个培训阶段.
在具有不同任务的跨医院适应环境、PFM、MIL架构和域适应目标中进行评估,AdaptMIL持续改进了纯源培训,并超越了替代适应方法。

blocks.en:
Our work has several limitations.
We primarily evaluate MIL models trained from scratch,
which is the most common setting and offers flexibility in the choice of the PFM ( Shao et al., 2025 ) .
Another approach is to use pretrained MIL models, which avoid training from scratch but are tied to specific PFM features.
Our TITAN experiments show that AdaptMIL can be applied in this setting, although broader evaluation remains for future work.
A further limitation is that AdaptMIL depends on the quality of the PFM representations and may not be able to compensate for strong representation biases.
Combining AdaptMIL with end-to-end PFM fine-tuning ( Kumar and Vanderbilt, 2026 ) is therefore an interesting direction for future work.
Finally, our survival prediction results (in Supp.) show that AdaptMIL improves in this setting, while standard UDA can sometimes be effective, motivating further study of when decoupling domain alignment from MIL aggregation is necessary.
blocks.zh:
我们的工作有几个局限性。
我们主要评估从零开始训练的MIL模型,
(Shao等人,2025年)。
另一种方法是使用预先训练的MIL模型,它避免从零开始训练,但与具体的PFM特征挂钩.
我们的TITAN实验表明,适应性MIL可以在此背景下应用,尽管更广泛的评价还有待于今后的工作.
另一个限制是,适应性MIL取决于PFM代表的质量,可能无法弥补强烈的代表偏差。
组合适应 因此,具有端对端PFM微调的MIL(Kumar and Vanderbilt, 2026)是未来工作的有趣方向.
最后,我们的生存预测结果(在Supp.中)表明,适应MIL在此环境下有所改进,而标准UDA有时可能有效,从而促使进一步研究何时有必要将域与MIL聚合脱钩。

blocks.en:
We focus on cross-hospital domain adaptation in digital pathology, but AdaptMIL may also apply to other MIL settings affected by a domain shift.
Examples include shifts between frozen and formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissues in pathology ( Ozyoruk et al., 2022 ) , as well as MIL applications in other domains such as medical imaging ( Cheplygina et al., 2019 ) and remote sensing ( Paheding et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们专注于数字病理学中的跨医院域适应,但适应MIL也可能适用于受域位转移影响的其他MIL环境.
实例包括病理学中冰冻和固定的石蜡-嵌合组织之间的转移(Ozyoruk等人,2022年),以及医学成像(Cheplygina等人,2019年)和遥感(Paheding等人,2024年)等其他领域的MIL应用.

blocks.en: Appendix A Implementation details
blocks.zh: 附录A 实施情况

blocks.en:
We provide the implementation details used across the evaluated PFMs and MIL architectures.
We use the AdamW optimizer ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) with a cosine learning rate schedule ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017 ) , starting at 10 − 4 10^{-4} and decaying to zero.
Each AdaptMIL stage uses its own cosine schedule (the schedule is restarted at the beginning of Stage 2).
The classifier is the only module trained in both stages and is carried over from Stage 1 to Stage 2.
blocks.zh:
我们提供了经过评价的PFM和MIL架构中使用的执行细节。
我们使用 AdamW 优化器(Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019年) , 采用 余弦学习率表(Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017年),从 10 – 4 10 – 4 } 开始,衰落到 0 .
每个适应MIL阶段都使用自己的余弦排程(该排程在第二阶段开始时重新开始).
分类器是两个阶段培训的唯一模块,从第一阶段转到第二阶段。

blocks.en:
We use a batch size of 16, with each batch balanced across source and target domains (i.e., 8 source samples and 8 target samples).
We additionally balance the labeled source samples within each batch by class, using an equal number of examples from each class.
The adaptation coefficient λ \lambda is 2.5 for MMD, 1.0 for LMMD, 15 for CORAL, and 1.0 for DANN (also see Sec. D.4 ).
blocks.zh:
我们使用16个批量规模,每批量在源域和目标域之间保持平衡(即8个源样本和8个目标样本)。
此外,我们利用每一类中相同数目的例子,在各批次内对标注的源样品进行分类平衡。
适应系数QQ\lambda为:MMD2.5,LMMD1.0,CORAL15,DANN1.0(另见Sec.D.4.

blocks.en:
For the domain-adaptation objectives, we build on public implementations.
We use multi-kernel MMD, CORAL, and DANN from TLlib ( Jiang et al., 2020 ) , and LMMD from Transfer Learning Repo ( Wang and others, 2018 ) .
All experiments are conducted in mixed precision on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 GPU.
blocks.zh:
关于域-适应目标,我们在公共执行的基础上更进一步。
我们使用多内核MMD,CORAL,以及来自TLLIB(Jiang等人,2020年)的DANN,以及来自Transfer Learning Repo(Wang等人,2018年)的LMD.
所有实验都以混合精度在单NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 GPU上进行.

blocks.en:
Our ABMIL implementation is based on MIL-Lab ( Shao et al., 2025 ) .
The slide embedding dimension and internal attention dimension are set to match the dimensionality of each PFM’s patch representations.
blocks.zh:
我们ABMIL的实施基于MIL-Lab(Shao等人,2025年)。
幻灯片嵌入维度和内部关注维度被设定为匹配每个PFM补丁表达的维度.

blocks.en:
We use the multi-class DSMIL formulation ( Li et al., 2021 ) , with the implementation from MIL-Lab ( Shao et al., 2025 ) .
Unlike ABMIL, DSMIL produces a class-specific slide representation for each class rather than a single slide embedding.
For domain adaptation, we concatenate the two class-specific representations and apply the adaptation objective to the resulting embedding.
The remaining implementation details follow ABMIL, as DSMIL similarly applies a patch-level projection followed by attention-based aggregation.
blocks.zh:
我们使用多级DSMIL配方(Li等人,2021年),由MIL-Lab(Shao等人,2025年)实施.
与ABMIL不同,DSMIL为每个类制作一个特定类的幻灯片表示,而不是一个单一的幻灯片嵌入.
对于域位适应,我们归纳了两个分类特定表述,并将适应目标应用到由此产生的嵌入中.
其余的执行细节是ABMIL,因为DSMIL同样采用了补丁级的预测,然后是关注的汇总。

blocks.en:
TITAN ( Ding et al., 2025 ) consists of a pre-trained transformer that takes CONCH-1.5 ( Lu et al., 2024 ) patch embeddings as input and produces contextualized patch representations,
followed by a pooling module that aggregates them into a single slide embedding.
A natural AdaptMIL decomposition would treat the transformer as the projection component and the pooling module as the aggregation component.
However, due to memory constraints and TITAN’s limited batch-size support, we keep the transformer frozen and insert a trainable linear projection between the transformer and the pooler.
The projection is trained in Stage 1. In Stage 2, we keep it frozen and fine-tune the pooling module.
blocks.zh:
TITAN(Ding等人,2025年)包括一个经过预先训练的变压器,将CONCH-1.5(Lu等人,2024年)补丁嵌入作为输入,并产生上下文的补丁表示,
然后是集合模块,将其聚合成一个幻灯片嵌入。
自然适应的MIL分解将把变压器作为投影组件,集合模块作为聚合组件.
然而,由于内存限制和TITAN有限的批量支持,我们保持变压器的冷却,并在变压器和电池之间插入可训练的线性投影.
投影在第一阶段训练 在第二阶段 我们保持冷冻 并微调集合模块

blocks.en:
We describe the implementation details of the different baselines.
For a fair comparison, single-stage UDA uses the same training configuration as AdaptMIL, except that training is performed in a single stage.
We train it for 80 epochs, matching the total number of epochs used across the two AdaptMIL stages.
blocks.zh:
我们描述了不同基线的执行细节。
为了进行公平的比较,单阶段UDA使用与AdapitalMIL相同的训练配置,但训练是在一个阶段进行的.
我们训练它80个纪元, 匹配整个两个适应性MIL阶段使用的纪元总数。

blocks.en: Appendix C Statistical tests
blocks.zh: 附录C 统计测试

blocks.en:
We provide details on the statistical tests reported in Appendix D for balanced accuracy and top-50 attention mass.
Statistical significance is assessed using a two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test over the 30 source–target hospital combinations in the TCGA NSCLC dataset.
For each source–target combination, we first average the relevant metric across the three cross-validation folds and then compute the difference between the compared methods (e.g., AdaptMIL vs. source-only ERM or single-stage UDA vs. source-only ERM).
We note that the Wilcoxon signed-rank test assumes independence across these differences, whereas in our setting the same hospital appears in multiple source–target combinations.
We therefore interpret the statistical results with this limitation in mind.
blocks.zh:
我们详细介绍了附录D中报告的平衡准确性和最高50关注质量的统计测试。
在TCGA NSCLC数据集中,对30个来源-目标医院组合进行了双侧Wilcoxon签名排名测试,评估了统计意义。
对于每个源-目标组合,我们首先在三个交叉验证折叠中平均相关衡量标准,然后计算比较方法之间的差别(例如,Adapital vs. 仅源机构风险管理或单阶段UDA vs. 仅源机构风险管理)。
Wilcoxon的签名排位测试假设在这些差异中具有独立性,而在我们设置同一医院时,则出现在多个源-目标组合中。
因此,我们铭记这一局限性来解释统计结果。

blocks.en: D.2 Additional attention and optimization analysis

blocks.en:
To further support the attention analysis in Sec. 3.2 and Fig. 2(a) , we perform two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests ( α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 ) on the top-50 attention mass in the TCGA NSCLC dataset.
Across all 12 PFM and adaptation method combinations, single-stage UDA yields a higher average top-50 attention mass than ERM on held-out target slides, with the difference being statistically significant in 11 of the 12 settings.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步支持第3.2节和图2(a)中的关注度分析,我们在TCGA NSCLC数据集的顶-50关注度质量上进行双侧的Wilcoxon签名级测试(α = 0.05\alpha = 0.05).
在所有12种PFM和适应方法组合中,单级UDA在持有目标幻灯片上的平均关注质量高于机构风险管理,在12种情况下的11种情况下,差异在统计学上显著。

blocks.en:
Conversely, AdaptMIL produces a more distributed attention pattern than ERM in all 12 settings, with statistically significant differences in 11 of the 12 settings.
We hypothesize that this occurs because Stage 1 learns the projection using mean pooling, which aggregates patch representations uniformly, and this affects the attention patterns subsequently learned in Stage 2.
blocks.zh:
相反, " 适应MIL " 在所有12个环境中产生比机构风险管理更分散的关注模式,12个环境中的11个在统计学上存在显著差异。
我们假设会发生这种情况,因为第一阶段用平均集合来学习投影,这个集合将补丁表达统一起来,这影响了随后在第二阶段学到的注意模式.

blocks.en: D.3 Survival prediction
blocks.zh: D.3 生存预测

blocks.en:
In the main paper, we evaluate AdaptMIL on three classification tasks.
Here, we additionally consider a non-classification task: survival prediction, which ranks patients according to their disease-specific survival risk.
We use 312 patients from the TCGA kidney renal clear cell carcinoma (KIRC) cohort across three hospitals.
Evaluation is performed using leave-one-out hospital evaluation with 5-fold cross-validation, and performance is measured using the concordance index (C-Index).
blocks.zh:
在主要论文中,我们评价了AdaptMIL的三个分类任务.
在这里,我们进一步考虑一项非分类任务:生存预测,它根据患者的疾病特定生存风险进行排序。
我们使用来自TCGA肾肾清细胞癌(KIRC)组的312名患者,分布在三家医院.
评估采用 " 医院一停 " 式评价,并进行5倍的交叉鉴定,使用 " 一致性指数 " (C-Index)衡量业绩。

blocks.zh:

然而,与分类任务不同,单阶段的UDA同样有效,甚至优于AdapitalMIL,虽然边距大多很小.

blocks.en:
We observe an increase in attention concentration under single-stage UDA, as shown in Fig. 2(a) for NSCLC subtyping and in the other classification tasks.
However, the increase in top-50 attention mass is much smaller for survival prediction. For example, with UNI and MMD it increases by only 1.2 × 1.2\times , compared with 2.8 × 2.8\times for NSCLC subtyping.
This suggests that the interaction between domain adaptation and MIL aggregation may depend on the downstream task. Nevertheless, AdaptMIL still improves over source-only training across all evaluated PFMs, suggesting a more robust choice when the effectiveness of single-stage UDA is uncertain.

blocks.en: D.5 Runtime
blocks.zh: D.5 运行时间

blocks.en:
We measure the training time of AdaptMIL-MMD with UNI.
Training a single source–target model takes 27.6 seconds on average for a TCGA NSCLC fold, compared with 47.6 seconds for single-stage UDA and 21.7 seconds for source-only ERM.
AdaptMIL is therefore approximately 1.7 × 1.7\times faster than single-stage UDA.
This is because Stage 1 uses the computationally cheaper mean-pooling aggregation, and Stage 2 does not compute the domain adaptation objective. In contrast, single-stage UDA uses both learned MIL aggregation and the adaptation objective throughout training.
blocks.zh:
我们用UNI测量适应MIL-MMD的训练时间。
培训单一来源-目标模型平均需要27.6秒的TCGA NSCLC折叠,而单阶段的UDA则需要47.6秒,唯一来源的机构风险管理则需要21.7秒。
因此,适应MIL大约比单级UDA快1.7×1.7\时.
这是因为第1阶段使用计算更便宜的平均集合,第2阶段不计算域位适应目标. 与此相反,单阶段的UDA在整个培训过程中既采用了学到的MIL汇总方法,也采用了适应目标。
